title: The source repair fixes preprocessing, not the BRDF model
caption: Identical 0-0.3 display limits; native background remains visible in historical support. Median raw boundary jumps are about 0.003 candidate units in both sources. No corrected output was used to choose the boundary.

title: Filtering is a sequence of explicit eligibility decisions
caption: Every sixth cell, same grid/north-up. Legacy mixing is estimated by bilinear source-alpha weights, not a brightness cutoff. Numerical geometry eligibility does not establish genuine views: actual Goldhill directional support remains absent.

title: Rejection is not an artifact-free corrected image
caption: A/B are pinned historical replays. C/D use revised prefit populations and historical equations; stable rank 1 prevents application. E uses current shared mathematics and gates. F has no applicable independent directional information; no coefficients or image are invented.

title: Fixed native red-boundary ROI
caption: P165ROI rows573:974,columns812:1313,0.1m,north-up. Identical display bounds saturate enormous diagnostic values; native ranges are reported separately. Gray panels indicate absent/unsupported products, not zero reflectance or successful artifact removal.

title: A 0.1 m boundary acquires an enormous algorithmic jump
caption: At columns 980/981 the clean raw jump is 0.001117; the clean-source historical BRDF jump is 674,321 candidate-equivalent units. The same fixed transect and reference pixels are used for every branch; no smoothing or factor clipping.

title: The historical prediction crosses zero; the old guard switches regimes
caption: The predicted red denominator is 0 outside and 0.0078125 inside at the fixed adjacent pair; reference prediction 91,740.234375 produces factor 11,742,750. Plotted denominator limits and sampled factor histograms do not alter the full-scene analytical summaries.

title: Current kernels already satisfy the mathematical reference tests
caption: Current RossThick/LiDenseR equations are unchanged in this task. The earlier repair removed spurious nadir azimuth response; it cannot recover real observation directions. The fresh targeted suite reruns the independent reference fixtures, reciprocity and wrapping tests.

title: Millions of pixels cannot replace missing angular dimensions
caption: Stable rank is tied to the existing precision condition limit 1/sqrt(float32epsilon). Algebraic rank and singular values are also retained. Pixel counts are not an estimated independent sample size; spatial/effective sampling uncertainty remains explicit.

title: Camera records leave hundreds of possible contributors per point
caption: Positions are real records; the right-hand envelope assumes their numbers are 26913 and altitude shares the delivered surface datum, with an illustrative nadir diagonal-FOV cone. It is not recovered viewing geometry, true image coverage, a probability distribution or a per-pixel assignment.

title: A reduced model needs external directional assumptions
caption: Synthetic algebra only, evaluated at the actual Goldhill nadir design. Each coefficient family predicts 0.3 at observed geometry but allows reference 0.15,0.3 or 0.6. No example is a Goldhill fit or applied model; isotropic-only assumptions give identity, not an estimated BRDF correction.

title: A known boundary-crossing polygon acquires a distorted spectrum
caption: The pre-existing Deciduous exemplar is selected by P165identity, not by new branch quality. Histories are reexpressed through the documented per-band inverse encoding; calibration remains hypothetical. Unsupported revised BRDF spectra are absent, not replaced with raw values.

title: Historical BRDF does not improve this matched identification test
caption: 157 polygon identities, four recorded classes, identical 3 fold splits, training-only scaling, C=1;499 permutations for separate spectral-separability tables. Intervals bootstrap fixed OOF predictions by class/identity. C/D/E/F have no supported image and no quality score; topographic score is unapproved diagnostic evidence.

title: Supported NEON correction is preserved by the reliability changes
caption: Actual 2021R10C directional data, fixed 120 x 3000 native window, ten nearest native channels; both BRDF-only and combined models support 10/10 bands. Values and masks are identical before/after. This bounded regression control is not a MicaSense calibration transfer or full-flightline accuracy claim.

title: One mathematical core, different evidence prerequisites
caption: Both pipelines retain BRDF requests and the same kernels, reference, physical decoder and ratio direction. Source acquisition/calibration/geometry remain platform-specific. A missing prerequisite is an explicit scientific block, not a successful uncorrected substitute.
